title: service.yaml
name: service.yaml
description: The service author writes service.yaml in the project root, and Parse reads it whole through the strict decoder. Its children are kept in the same file.

title: ValidationResult
name: ValidationResult
description: Validate computes the faults on each request, and nothing keeps them.

title: lifecycle.yaml
name: lifecycle.yaml
description: Not written yet. The lifecycle records will be kept beside the registry and read from its current head; the file's name is not decided.

title: qualification.json
name: qualification.json
description: qualify writes qualification.json whole into a new result folder, with the required jobs and the release assets in it.

title: build.json
name: build.json
description: verify copies the compiler binary and its signed build.json into a new result folder.

title: fleet.Sweep
name: fleet.Sweep
description: Not written yet. The sweep will compute the fleet on each request from the committed records in the named checkouts, and keep nothing.

title: lifecycle.Standing
name: lifecycle.Standing
description: Not written yet. It will be computed on each request from the service's record and the digest lifecycle.

title: buildidentity.Record
name: buildidentity.Record
description: fromInfo computes it on each run from the compiler's own build information.

title: fill.yaml
name: fill.yaml
description: Each fills/<name>/fill.yaml, with the fill's evidence and sign-off in the same file. The fill's code and tests sit beside it.

title: main.runRegistryFills
name: main.runRegistryFills
description: Computed on each request from the project's fills, and kept nowhere.

title: fill.Qualification
name: fill.Qualification
description: Not written yet. It will be computed on each run from the bound fills, and kept nowhere.

title: .stego/state.yaml
name: .stego/state.yaml
description: SaveState writes .stego/state.yaml whole, and LoadState reads it. The service commits it with the generated code.

title: .stego/transaction.yaml
name: .stego/transaction.yaml
description: prepareTransaction writes .stego/transaction.yaml before an apply changes a file, and the apply or its recovery removes it when done.

title: .stego/plan.yaml
name: .stego/plan.yaml
description: Not written yet. stego plan will write the saved plan under .stego/, as local working state that is not committed; the file's name is not decided.

title: compiler.DriftResult
name: compiler.DriftResult
description: DetectDrift computes it on each request, and nothing keeps it.

title: compiler.Plan
name: compiler.Plan
description: Reconcile computes the plan on each run. The saved plan, ST-GEN-EN06, is the form that is kept.

title: registry/
name: registry/
description: A folder tree, read only, not one file: LoadDirectories captures each source folder and its archetypes, components and mixins. The registry sources are kept with it.

title: output_namespace
name: component.yaml
description: The output_namespace field in each components/<name>/component.yaml, read with its component.

title: archetype.yaml
name: archetype.yaml
description: Each archetypes/<name>/archetype.yaml in a registry source, with its component bindings in the same file.

title: mixin.yaml
name: mixin.yaml
description: Each mixins/<name>/mixin.yaml in a registry source, with the slot contracts it adds in its slots folder.

title: port.yaml
name: port.yaml
description: Not written yet: a port exists today only as a name on the components that require or provide it. Its file's name and place in the registry are not decided.

title: slots/<slot>.proto
name: slots/<slot>.proto
description: Each slot is declared in its component.yaml or mixin.yaml, and its protobuf contract is the slots/<slot>.proto file beside it.

title: component.yaml
name: component.yaml
description: Each components/<name>/component.yaml in a registry source.

title: main.runRegistryInspect
name: main.runRegistryInspect
description: stego registry inspect computes it on each request from the active registry, and prints it.

title: main.runRegistrySearch
name: main.runRegistrySearch
description: stego registry search computes it on each request from the active registry, and prints it.

title: registry.ComponentConsumers
name: registry.ComponentConsumers
description: Not written yet. It will be computed on each request from the services' records, and keep nothing.
